motor.phi.name: motor.phi
motor.phi.description: Angle of flange with respect to support (= flange.phi - support.phi)

motor.useSupport.name: motor.useSupport
motor.useSupport.description: = true, if support flange enabled, otherwise implicitly grounded

motor.tau_constant.name: motor.tau_constant
motor.tau_constant.description: Constant torque (if negative, torque is acting as load in positive direction of rotation)

motor.w.name: motor.w
motor.w.description: Angular velocity of flange with respect to support (= der(phi))

rotor.w.name: rotor.w
rotor.w.description: Absolute angular velocity of component (= der(phi))

rotor.a.name: rotor.a
rotor.a.description: Absolute angular acceleration of component (= der(w))

gear.useSupport.name: gear.useSupport
gear.useSupport.description: = true, if support flange enabled, otherwise implicitly grounded

gear.phi_a.name: gear.phi_a
gear.phi_a.description: Angle between left shaft flange and support

gear.phi_b.name: gear.phi_b
gear.phi_b.description: Angle between right shaft flange and support

load.w.name: load.w
load.w.description: Absolute angular velocity of component (= der(phi))

load.a.name: load.a
load.a.description: Absolute angular acceleration of component (= der(w))

spring.phi_nominal.name: spring.phi_nominal
spring.phi_nominal.description: Nominal value of phi_rel (used for scaling)

spring.lossPower.name: spring.lossPower
spring.lossPower.description: Loss power leaving component via heatPort (> 0, if heat is flowing out of component)

brakeTorque.useSupport.name: brakeTorque.useSupport
brakeTorque.useSupport.description: = true, if support flange enabled, otherwise implicitly grounded

maxSpeed.name: maxSpeed
maxSpeed.description: Load speed threshold for brake engagement [rad/s]

model_description: Geared oscillator with automatic speed-limiting brake
